rules.statement: An executor is entitled to claim the benefit of the Prescription Ordinance in Ceylon, even when he is not an express trustee under the will.
rules.supporting_quote: This decision is in keeping with section 111 of our Trusts Ordinance, No. 9 of 1917, which mentions the cases where the Prescription Ordinance is inapplicable in respect of trusts, and adds in clause (5) �This section shall not apply to constructive trusts, except in so far as such trusts are treated as express trusts by the law of England�.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 111 of our Trusts Ordinance, No. 9 of 1917

meta.parties: De Silva Et Al. v. De Silva
